reviews.review_title: Crossy Road Gets a Stressful VR Makeover
reviews.review_description:
HOPROUTE VR is a fun, cozy, yet surprisingly addictive VR game! The concept is reminiscent of Crossy Road, but playing it in VR takes the experience to a whole new level. You don't just watch traffic approaching on a screen; you see it coming straight at you and almost feel the impact when a car, rocket, elephant, or even a plane takes you out because you miscalculated your timing!

The gameplay is simple to understand but surprisingly challenging. You need to assess distances, anticipate movements, identify safe opportunities, and decide when to take a risk. Sounds familiar? It's a bit like real-life road crossing: you think you have enough time, accelerate to make it across, and suddenly hear someone beeping because you've made a rather questionable decision!

Jokes aside, there's actually an interesting educational aspect here. It could be a great tool for teaching younger players about road safety, risk assessment, timing, and developing better instincts when crossing roads.

Another excellent feature is the addition of a high-level viewing mode. You can seamlessly switch to a higher perspective to strategise, assess the environment, and plan your next moves. The transition is smooth and feels naturally integrated into the gameplay.

With around 8 to 10 different worlds to discover, there's already plenty to explore. And since the game is still in Early Access, hopefully there's plenty more chaos coming our way!

A simple concept, cleverly adapted to VR, with great potential for both entertainment and educational use. Cozy, challenging, and much more addictive than you might expect. Highly recommended!
